description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractController' for web controllers in a Spring MVC application, providing common utility methods for session management, error handling, and pagination.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract controller providing session management, error handling, and pagination utilities for web controllers in a Spring MVC application.

methods.name: getSessionAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the HTTP session based on a key.

methods.name: setSessionAttribute
methods.description: Sets a value in the HTTP session for a given key.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute from the HTTP session based on a key.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the Language object stored in the request attributes.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown in controllers, providing error views for access denied and general errors.

methods.name: createPaginaionData
methods.description: Creates a PaginationData object given page number and size.

methods.name: calculatePaginaionData
methods.description: Updates PaginationData with total result count.
